recognize_zh: 視野內有許多核圓、染色質細緻、胞質藍的母細胞，但同時穿插帶粗大嗜天青顆粒的前骨髓細胞與開始出現核周淡染區（hof）的較成熟細胞；母細胞增加又能看到顆粒球往下成熟，符合有成熟的 AML（AML with maturation）。
features: Numerous blasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli and basophilic cytoplasm
Admixed promyelocytes and myelocytes with abundant coarse azurophilic granules
Some cells with eccentric nuclei and perinuclear hof, indicating granulocytic maturation
Cells with variable granulation, including hypogranular forms
Very cellular aspirate with few erythroid precursors
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is densely cellular and composed of increased myeloblasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and moderately basophilic cytoplasm. Admixed are numerous promyelocytes and myelocytes with coarse azurophilic granules and perinuclear hofs, demonstrating granulocytic maturation, with variable granulation among maturing cells. Erythroid precursors are sparse. No convincing Auer rods are identified at this magnification. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with maturation, pending blast enumeration and cytogenetic studies to exclude t(8;21) and other defining abnormalities.

ddx.vs: Often looks like AML with maturation, but t(8;21) blasts are large with salmon-colored cytoplasm, single slender Auer rods and pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules, and the translocation is confirmatory.
APL shows a near-uniform population of hypergranular abnormal promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and Auer rod bundles, rather than a mix of blasts and orderly maturing granulocytes.
MDS-IB has <20% blasts in marrow, so the distinction rests on the blast count.
